findings.title: Readiness probe failing
findings.cause: container web runs but its readiness probe times out: the app does not answer within the probe's 1s timeoutSeconds, so it gets no traffic; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: Readiness probe failed: command timed out: "sh -c sleep 3; wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8080/" timed out after 1s

evidence.what: container web is running but not ready

findings.fix: Raise the readiness probe's timeoutSeconds above how long the check takes (it is 1s), or make the health check cheaper: one that waits on a database or another service is slow whenever they are.
